notes: Descriptive only; no decision rule (protocol 18 Section 6.7, Part A).
mSCF1 is S3PL's own in-job evaluator (metrics.json), not the fair-scoring evaluator.
The final loss is the last-batch MSE of epoch 10 (train_history), not an epoch mean.
A seed index has no shared meaning across sections, so the (1|seed) component is expected near zero; seed-to-seed variation within a section appears in the residual (the section x seed interaction).
Preliminary set: GBM and CAC use different seed modes (see seed_mode). The primary decomposition is the same analysis on released seeds 1-10 after Part B.
The largest gap is the largest difference between consecutive sorted seed scores in a section; it is a descriptive bimodality item and no bimodality wording is fixed.
